name: Multi-CAD Geometry Kernel Benchmark
description: Standardized engineering reference dataset and cross-kernel benchmark comparing boundary representation (B-Rep) tolerances, linear/angular precision thresholds, and translation discrepancy rates across major commercial and open-source geometric modeling kernels (Siemens Parasolid, Spatial ACIS, Open CASCADE Technology, and Dassault CGM). Provides empirical data on STEP AP242 / IGES translation errors, non-manifold sewing recovery, and spatial coordinate mapping for multi-disciplinary aerospace, automotive, and AEC pipelines. Maintained by the CADGuide.tools Engineering Hub.Interactive Online Tools & Research Matrix:- Multi-CAD Architecture & Specification Matrix- Client-Side DWG & Header Inspector- Engineering Tools & Calculators- CAD Architecture & Diagnostic Guides- CADGuide.tools Official Portal
